thread:
jess_cust_success: FYI ACME hit repeated 429s right after they ramped traffic during onboarding. They say it’s only in eu-west and only from their Android builds. Logs attached below.

raj_engineer: thanks — can you paste a failing request/response pair (headers + rate-limit response) so I can see how the server is classifying them?

jess_cust_success: pasted from customer: ```
Request headers:
Authorization: Bearer <token masked>
X-Client-Version: android-2.4.1
X-Tenant-ID: 
Content-Type: application/json

Response (429):
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "limit": "requests_per_minute",
  "scope": "anonymous",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```

maria_sdk: :eyes: that `X-Tenant-ID` being blank is suspicious. SDK v0.8.3 had a retry-path bug where custom headers weren't reattached on token refresh. If header missing requests are counted under the default anonymous bucket for the region.

raj_engineer: yep — our routing tallies by `X-Tenant-ID` first, then api-key. Missing header => falls back to `anonymous` bucket which has a much tighter RPM. That would explain eu-west spike if their mobile clients occasionally drop header on background refresh.

jess_cust_success: customer says they set tenant in init but some flows call `refreshToken()` and then the header disappears.

maria_sdk: repro steps — initialize SDK with `tenantId: 'acme-71'`, then trigger token auto-refresh while a request is inflight. On v0.8.3 the retry path created a new fetch without copying `defaultHeaders`. Fix landed in 0.8.5. Workarounds: (1) upgrade to >=0.8.5; (2) explicitly set header on each request `setDefaultHeader('X-Tenant-ID', 'acme-71')`; (3) server-side temporary whitelist.

raj_engineer: @ops_oncall can we apply a short whitelist for `acme-71` in eu-west while they upgrade? :pray:

ops_oncall: granted temporary override. Whitelisted tenant `acme-71` in eu-west for 12 minutes (id 5752). I'll keep an eye on the per-region counters. :thumbsup:

jess_cust_success: ACME upgraded to SDK 0.8.5; they say 429s stopped after ~2 minutes. I'll keep them on watch for 30m and then close the loop.

raj_engineer: I filed a note to add an onboarding bullet: "Ensure X-Tenant-ID persists across token refreshes" and will add the version requirement to the quickstart. Also documenting server behavior that missing `X-Tenant-ID` => anonymous bucket.

maria_sdk: filing SDK repo issue #452 and backporting patch to 0.8.x.

jess_cust_success: thanks all — I'll follow up with ACME and capture their feedback that the SDK behavior was unexpected. If stable I'll mark as resolved in the ticket in 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy status: no active deploys affecting eu-west inference routing.

jess_cust_success: resolution update (30m): ACME confirmed stable, no further 429s. Closing thread.
